cancel(uint256).notice: Cancel an unsettled deal and refund whatever was deposited.         Either party can cancel at any time before settlement. After the deadline, anyone can.

createDeal((address,address,address,addr.notice: The buyer opens a deal. `p.seller` is the address that will deposit the tokens (in Ghost mode a fresh         one-time wallet). `p.sellerPayout` receives the proceeds, so the payout never touches the depositing         wallet. `p.buyerReceive` receives the tokens (0x0 = the buyer). `q` is Bull's signed fee quote for exactly         these parameters.

deals(uint256).notice: Reads a deal. Returned as one struct: the ABI encoding is the same as 13 separate return values.

fundPayment(uint256).notice: Buyer deposits the payment. For ERC-20 payments, approve this contract first.

fundTokens(uint256).notice: Seller deposits the tokens. Approve this contract first.

fundTokensWithPermit(uint256,uint256,uin.notice: Gasless deposit for the seller (Ghost mode). The seller signs an EIP-2612 permit offline with the         one-time wallet; anyone (a relayer) can submit it and pay the gas, so the one-time wallet never needs         ETH and never has to be funded from a traceable wallet. Tokens move only from `d.seller`, and only for         exactly `sellAmount` to this contract, so a third party cannot misdirect anything.
